Drummer Ralph Humphrey was born in Berkeley, California on May 11, 1944.

Following graduation from San Jose State College he was chosen to fill the drum chair in the Don Ellis Orchestra. Ralph has played with Frank Zappa, John Klemmer, Al Jarreau and on innumerable studio dates. He has authored a number of percussion method books and directed the Percussion Institute of Technology with Jeff Porcaro.
Ralph was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 11, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Toronto at the IAJE convention filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton. I’m pleased to have Ralph Humphrey with me today. Our viewers won’t know it but I just had the pleasure of attending a little clinic you did.
